issues.claim: Dave & Son Lawn & Landscaping (website daveandsonlandscaping.com) is an East Brunswick landscaper
issues.problem: Out of zone. The site is built around Marlboro (page title 'Marlboro Landscaping, Property Management and Lawn Maintenance') and its own contact page carries an Old Bridge mailing address per the site's search summary; East Brunswick appears only as a service page. The list's own caveat says out-of-town contractors were to be excluded.
issues.fix: Remove, or re-file it as an out-of-town advertiser serving East Brunswick rather than a zone business. Verify with the contact page address before any outreach.

issues.claim: Ace World Wide Moving & Storage, East Brunswick (address 'Unknown')
issues.problem: Borderline excluded type and unconfirmed base: Ace World Wide is a national household-goods brand whose own contact page gives a Cudahy, Wisconsin headquarters; the 'East Brunswick' reference is a 24 Connerty Ct third-party listing with no address in the mapper's record. Inference: like Sweeney's Gulf it may be an independently owned agent, but that is not established.
issues.fix: Drop unless it can be shown to be an independently owned local agent, consistent with how Two Men and a Truck and 1-800-GOT-JUNK were excluded.

issues.claim: Ace Walco East Brunswick, 44 West Ferris Street
issues.problem: Ace Walco is a multi-branch New Jersey pest-control brand (its BBB profile is filed under Linden, not East Brunswick); the East Brunswick reference is a Birdeye branch listing with 5 reviews. Not a national franchise, but not a single-shop local operator either.
issues.fix: Keep only if the team wants multi-branch regional operators; otherwise demote. Add a note that the corporate base is Linden.

issues.claim: Lead-generation style entries: Finer Things Garage Door Repair (eastbrunswickgaragedoor.com), Neighborhood Locksmith Store East Brunswick, East Brunswick Towing, Tulip Carpet Cleaning, Certified Appliance Repair East Brunswick, East Brunswick Appliance Repair, National Roofers of East Brunswick, Neighborhood Roofing East Brunswick, Pro Garage Door Repair East Brunswick
issues.problem: These are town-keyword domains or town-suffixed names with no street address and templated copy (the locksmith site is visibly template-built). They may be paid-lead brands rather than single local operators, which would make cold outreach wasted or misdirected.
issues.fix: Verify each against a state registration or a genuine local address before assigning; low priority for the team.

issues.claim: Missing websites and phones for entries that have them
issues.problem: Several confirmed businesses are recorded with blank website or phone even though public sites/numbers exist: Hollander Electric (hollanderelectric.com), Gold Medal Service (goldmedalservice.com), Property Management General Contracting (pmgcnj.com), Delta Contracting Services (deltaroofnj.com), Superior Decorating (superiordecoratingllc.com, 732-698-9988), Anton Plumbing (antonplumbinghvac.com), New Vision Electric (newvisionelectric.com, 732-484-1135), Catamount Roofing (iroofnj.com, 732-675-5207), Raritan Valley Tree Service (732-422-0351), A & W Tree Services (732-251-3955), WeatherSeal Roofing (732-576-3899), Biondo Contracting (732-257-2926), Paramount Exterminating (732-613-8700), Gillespie Group (732-254-5508).
issues.fix: Backfill website/phone from the business's own site before the team starts calling; a record with no phone is not actionable.

issues.claim: Duplicate street addresses: 28 Arthur Street (Artem HVAC and Anchor Pest Control), 471 Cranbury Road (Giancola Brothers and Gibraltar Car Care), 439 Old Bridge Turnpike (Lenny's Home Improvements and J & D Painting), 44 West Ferris Street (Paint Rite and Ace Walco), 2 Claire Road (Superior Decorating Suite E and Apex Appliance)
issues.problem: Shared addresses are common for small trade shops but some of these pairs may be one business listed twice or a shared office, which would double-count prospects.
issues.fix: Deduplicate on the first call pass; keep whichever name answers and note the relation.

issues.claim: Rojas Landscaping and Handyman Services LLC (sourced from a North Brunswick directory page; address 'Brier Hill Court Suite 206')
issues.problem: The cited source is a North Brunswick listing, so the record's provenance does not support the East Brunswick claim even though the business does appear at a Brier Hill Court, East Brunswick address elsewhere.
issues.fix: Re-source from an East Brunswick page (e.g. the Birdeye profile) and record the confirmed suite.

issues.claim: Dylan Landscaping LLC note says Bing geocoded it to Somerset, NJ
issues.problem: Coverage checks point the other way: the Angi East Brunswick listing gives 61 Rues Lane, East Brunswick and 732-770-3385, so the 'Somerset' doubt is probably wrong.
issues.fix: Correct the note and record the East Brunswick address.

issues.claim: Coverage gaps in categories the list already covers
issues.problem: My own searches turned up 8 eligible East Brunswick businesses that are not in the list (see coverage.missing), spread across plumbing, electrical, landscaping, auto repair, chimney, pool and house cleaning.
issues.fix: Add the missing entries, or note them for the next pass; only 4 of the 12 categories I searched were fully covered.

issues.claim: Entries resting on one unreadable directory (Angi, Yellow Pages, LocalSolution, BBB summaries)
issues.problem: Roughly two dozen records (Silvana, Home Maids Pro, Hortensia, Springview, Vonch's, AMS Restoration, Bio-Tech, All Season Chimney, All Handyman Services, Cazza, Alarm Distributors, Apex Appliance, A Plus Painting, CS Construction, BVM, Earle Asphalt, TDM Sealcoating, Central Asphalt) were taken from search summaries of pages that block direct reading, so existence in town is unverified.
issues.fix: Treat as unqualified until a second source or a live check confirms town; do not put them in the first outreach batch.
